messages:
maria: Pushed Chorus-14k (fp16) to staging. Did a quick wiki holdout pass, flagging a regression after int8 quant :eyes:
lee: Nice. Can you paste the eval commands?
maria: Sure:
```bash
./eval/recall.py --model chorus-14k-fp16 --dataset wiki-holdout --k 1,5,10 --quant none
./eval/recall.py --model chorus-14k-int8 --dataset wiki-holdout --k 1,5,10 --quant perchannel
```
devon: What metrics are you seeing?
maria: FP16 baseline: R@1=0.872, R@5=0.961, R@10=0.976
maria: INT8 per-channel: R@1=0.838 (-3.4%), R@5=0.953 (-0.8%), R@10=0.970 (-0.6%)
srinivas: Hm R@1 drop is concerning. What's the distribution by query length?
maria: Short queries (<8 tokens): R@1 drops 6.1% — long queries (>=32 tokens) basically unchanged.
lee: Any clustering or silhouette checks?
maria: Ran UMAP + HDBSCAN quick: cluster purity down .78 -> .72, silhouette .31 -> .24. Plot uploaded.
devon: Could be a quantized scale shift or asymmetric rounding. Did you try per-channel zero-point correction?
maria: Tried median-rescale per-channel (cheap correction) — R@1 improved to 0.854 (cuts gap by ~50%).
ci-bot: ci pipeline passed for chorus-14k-int8 (unit tests, lint) :white_check_mark:
srinivas: Also double-check similarity metric: are we L2-normalizing before NN? cosine vs dot matters after quant.
maria: Chorus outputs unnormalized. We normalize before nearest-neighbor. Tried dot on raw int8 -> much worse. Keeping cosine.
lee: Next steps: 1) run per-channel calibrator sweep (scale + bias) 2) rerun holdout with bootstrapped CIs 3) sanity on multilingual subset 4) compare to distill baseline
maria: Kicking off sweeps now, will post updated numbers. Uploading logs to s3://redwood-test/chorus/evals/1765432100/
lee: Also add a tiny integration smoke on Dedicated so we can assess latency impact of the calibrator.
devon: Add the calibration patch to the candidate branch so QA can smoke it.
maria: Will do. embedding dim=4096, quant target=int8 symmetric per-channel.
srinivas: If calibration helps, we should document the recommended default (median-rescale + per-channel bias) in the model onboarding checklist.
maria: Agreed. tagging @dev-oncall if this persists :eyes:
lee: ack.
